title: Pure Duel Dragon
summary: Pure Duel Dragon Synchro strategy inspired by the Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's manga, centered on the ancient creator dragons Ultimaya Tzolkin and Crimson Dragon. By using Rex Goodwin's canonical Supay and Ascator engines to assemble equal-Level Tuners and non-Tuners without locking Attributes, the deck sends Level 6 Synchros Coral Dragon and Stardust Charge Warrior to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin, triggering it with Scrap-Iron Statue to cheat out Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon and Beelze of the Diabolic Dragons.

summary.title: Starters
points: Supay, Duskwalker discards a card to Special Summon itself as a Level 5 non-Tuner and Special Summon Level 1 Tuner Supay from Deck to immediately Synchro Summon Level 6 Tuner Coral Dragon.
Ascator, Dawnwalker discards a card to Special Summon itself as a Level 5 non-Tuner and Special Summon Level 3 Tuner Fire Ant Ascator from Deck for instant Level 8 Duel Dragon plays.
Quickdraw Synchron provides a free Level 5 Tuner by discarding a monster, enabling direct Ultimaya Tzolkin setups alongside any Level 5 non-Tuner.
Scrap-Iron Statue negates an opponent face-up Spell or Trap and repeatedly Sets itself back face-down, continuously re-triggering Ultimaya Tzolkin's summon effect.

summary.title: Opening: Supay + Level 6 Setup
steps: Activate Supay, Duskwalker in hand, discarding a card to Special Summon itself and Special Summon Level 1 Tuner Supay from your Deck.
Synchro Summon Level 6 Synchro Tuner Coral Dragon using Level 5 Supay, Duskwalker and Level 1 Supay.
Assemble a Level 6 non-Tuner Synchro such as Stardust Charge Warrior, drawing 1 card upon summon.
Send Level 6 Tuner Coral Dragon and Level 6 non-Tuner Stardust Charge Warrior from field to GY to Special Summon Ultimaya Tzolkin from the Extra Deck, drawing 1 card from Coral Dragon.
Set Scrap-Iron Statue face-down, immediately triggering Ultimaya Tzolkin to cheat out Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon (or Beelze of the Diabolic Dragons) directly from your Extra Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ultimaya Tzolkin cannot be targeted for attacks or card effects while you control another Synchro Monster, and Special Summons a Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro or Power Tool Synchro from your Extra Deck whenever a Spell/Trap is Set on your field.
Crimson Dragon is a Level 12 Synchro that searches Synchro Rumble on summon and returns itself to the Extra Deck as a Quick Effect to summon a Dragon Synchro matching a targeted Synchro's Level.
Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon negates an opponent monster's activated effect once per turn, destroys it, and gains ATK equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK.
Beelze of the Diabolic Dragons cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, and gains ATK equal to any damage you take or that it takes in battle.
Stardust Spark Dragon targets 1 face-up card you control (including Ultimaya Tzolkin) once per turn as a Quick Effect to make it indestructible by battle or card effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Scrap-Iron Statue negates an opponent's face-up Spell or Trap card and Sets itself back face-down instead of going to the GY, continuously re-triggering Ultimaya Tzolkin on both players' turns.
Synchro Rumble revives a Tuner or Level 7/8 Dragon Synchro from your GY and protects your Synchro Monsters from battle destruction.
Power Tool Braver Dragon equips Metalsilver Armor and Life Extreme from your Deck on summon, forcing all opponent targeting onto Braver and altering battle stats.

allow.Supay, Duskwalker: Level 5 Earth Spellcaster that discards 1 card to Special Summon itself and Level 1 Tuner Supay from Deck to summon Level 6 Tuner Coral Dragon without locking Attributes (only locks Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters)!
allow.Supay: Level 1 Tuner summoned from Deck by Supay, Duskwalker to tune into Level 6 Coral Dragon.
allow.Ascator, Dawnwalker: Level 5 Earth Spellcaster that discards 1 card to Special Summon itself and Level 3 Tuner Fire Ant Ascator from Deck for instant Level 8 Duel Dragons under a Synchro-only Extra Deck lock.
allow.Fire Ant Ascator: Level 3 Tuner summoned by Ascator, Dawnwalker to make Level 8 Duel Dragons like Stardust Spark Dragon or Beelze.
allow.Synchro Rumble: Spell searchable by Crimson Dragon that revives a Tuner or Level 7/8 Dragon Synchro from the GY.
allow.Metalsilver Armor: Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that prevents the opponent from targeting any monster except the equipped one.
allow.Life Extreme: Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon that boosts ATK by 1500 and destroys a card when battle positions change.
allow.Coral Dragon: Level 6 Synchro Tuner made with Level 1 Supay + Level 5 Supay, Duskwalker; serves as the exact Level 5+ Tuner required to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin and draws 1 card when sent!
allow.Stardust Charge Warrior: Level 6 non-Tuner Synchro that draws 1 card and pairs with Coral Dragon to summon Ultimaya Tzolkin!

Level 12 Synchro that searches Synchro Rumble and returns itself to the Extra Deck as a Quick Effect to Synchro Summon any Dragon Synchro matching a targeted Synchro's Level.
Level 8 Dragon Synchro summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that negates any monster effect once per turn and gains ATK.
Signature Level 8 DARK Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and gains ATK whenever you take damage.

Signature Level 7 LIGHT Duel Dragon summoned by Ultimaya Tzolkin that bounces a Special Summoned monster the opponent controls.
